author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Movie stunts are about so much more than explosions, impressive choreography, and watching actors perform seemingly impossible feats. At their best, stunts can tell an entire story without a single word of dialogue.

From the incredible opening sequence of Baby Driver, to the breathtaking one-shot fight sequence in Kingsman: The Secret Service, and Fast Fives unforgettable practical stunt that pushed the limits of what audiences thought was possible on screen. Filmmakers have truly found ways to turn stunt work into an essential part of storytelling.

But how do these stunts come together? What makes them so memorable? And why does the best action filmmaking do more than simply look impressive?

00:07:51 - This Fast Five Stunt Was REAL

title: How Movie Stunts Tell Stories Without Saying A Word
